plan.name: Use the stove to heat the mug directly
plan.strategy: Find a mug, place it on a stove burner, heat it, and then put it in the coffeemachine.
steps: Look through cabinets, drawers, or shelves to locate a mug.
Take the mug to one of the stove burners.
Heat the mug on the stove until it becomes hot.
Once hot, move the mug to the coffeemachine and put it inside.
